ticket_number_extraction.description: Ticket number is an 8-digit number printed in bold in the upper-right corner, beside the 'Ticket No.:' label. OCR often splits it across two consecutive lines (e.g. '20321' then '064') — these are reassembled by the extraction logic.

facility_extraction.description: The quarry name appears below the 'KNIFE RIVER' header line and above the street address (the first line starting with a digit). No keyword label precedes it. The AI extraction step is responsible for identifying this field since there is no parseable label.

notes.qr_sticker: The QR code is a sticker added by MJ Hughes and can appear anywhere on the ticket. Do not use QR code position to determine which copy to process.
notes.duplicate_copies: Knife River prints a Customer Copy and an Office Copy on the same page. When two boundaries are detected, only the copy with the QR sticker is processed. QR detection drives the selection — not the position on the page.
notes.customer_format: Customer line contains a numeric ID followed by the company name (e.g. '23402  MJ HUGHES CONSTRUCTION INC'). The leading numeric ID should be ignored; extract the name only.
notes.material_format: Product line contains a 7-digit numeric product code followed by the description and then tonnage (e.g. '2499340  3/4"-0 CRUSHED  13.60 Ton'). NOTE: _clean_material only strips 2-4 digit codes; the 7-digit Knife River code will NOT be auto-stripped by OCR extraction. The AI extraction step handles this correctly.
notes.ticket_number_format: 8-digit number (e.g. 20321064), beside the 'Ticket No.:' label. OCR may split it across two lines (e.g. '20321' + '064'). The extraction logic handles reassembly of split numbers, and the AI prompt is told to do the same.
